tools.name: log_habit
tools.description: Log a habit the user just did. Name is the habit, in the user's words (EN or SR).

name.description: Habit name, e.g. creatine, Brush + floss, kreatin

tools.name: add_note
tools.description: Save a note. If it is a commitment, set want_date (yyyy-MM-dd or today/tomorrow).

tools.name: log_finance
tools.description: Log money. sign is in (income) or out (expense).

amount.description: Numeric amount as spoken, no currency symbol required

tools.name: complete_want
tools.description: Mark an upcoming Want as done. text matches the want body.

tools.name: query_balance
tools.description: Read the current money balance. No arguments.
